schema_notes.backtest_entry_date: Earliest defensible entry date: claimed_entry.date when it is earlier than entry_date, otherwise entry_date. Use it for backtests; entry_date/entry_post is the earliest posts.jsonl row carrying the evidence.
schema_notes.dates: Every *_date equals created_at[:10] (UTC) of the cited post. claimed_entry.date and quoted_date are the created_at of a quoted post; those quoted ids may not be rows in posts.jsonl.
schema_notes.entry_basis: stated | first_disclosed (first seen in a book or holding statement) | first_disclosed_at_exit | stated_intent | conditional_bid | recommendation | picks_tracker | inferred | hash_commitment_revealed | endorsement
schema_notes.exit_basis: stated | disclosed_after (exit reported after the fact, date of sale unknown) | disclosed_after_inferred | inferred | stated_intent
schema_notes.exit_window: No exit post: the position was in a posted holdings list (last_seen) and missing from the next one (first_absent). Below-1% or 'undisclosed' lines can hide it.
schema_notes.entry_price_stated: Upper bounds ('under $12', 'under $300') and limit bids are recorded as numbers and explained in note.
schema_notes.size: Weights exactly as stated, each with its post id.
schema_notes.baskets: Basket rows (MEMORY, NEOCLOUD, DATACENTER CAPEX) overlap ticker rows (SKHY, MU, SNDK, NVDA calls); do not double count.
schema_notes.pre_window: Some entries predate 2023-07-14 and are known only from self-quotes; claimed_entry carries that date.
